semantics.operation: Combinational sign extension: out[7:0] equals in, and each out[31:8] equals in[7].
semantics.timing_evidence: Original problem requires concatenation of 24 sign bits followed by the input; no clock or latency is specified.
semantics.reset_evidence: Original interface has no reset port.
semantics.initialization_evidence: No initial state is specified; output is solely a combinational function of input.

numeric.output_interpretation: 32-bit two's-complement representation of the same value
numeric.widths: 24 replicated sign bits plus 8 original bits

verification.oracle: For all 256 binary inputs, interpret the integer input as signed by subtracting 256 for values >=128 and compare its 32-bit representation.
verification.sampling: Drive input then wait one simulation time unit for combinational settling.
verification.four_state: Supplemental checks ensure unknown/high-impedance sign bits propagate and low input bits are retained.
verification.completion: Fatal on mismatches, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks.
